app.name: Habit Tracker
app.shortDescription: Day counter, activity log & days since tracker. Count how often you do anything.
app.tagline: Log it. Count it. Remember it.
app.elevatorPitch: Habit Tracker lets you log anything you do on a calendar and instantly see when, how often, and how long ago you did it — by month, quarter, or year.
app.brandPromise: Private by design. Your log lives on your phone.

logo.description: Twelve day-segments orbit a check mark. Nine are complete; a teal planet marks today's progress. Reads as 'a cycle of days, ticked off' — the core action of the app.
logo.clearSpace: 25% of mark width on every side

do: Use plain words: log, count, see
dont: Use exclamation marks more than once per screen
